game.title: Comet Dodge
game.objective: Steer a rocket through space to dodge incoming comets and asteroids while collecting stars to maximize score and distance.
game.controls: Touch and hold the left or right side of the screen to steer the rocket horizontally.
game.core_loop: Hold left or right to weave between falling comets -> catch stars and perform near-misses -> build combos and survive escalating hazard waves for a higher score.
features: Comet Wall obstacles with narrow gaps
game.progression: As distance increases, standard falling comets escalate into full-width Comet Walls with small gaps, swerving Zig-Zag comets, and Shield power-up spawns.
game.hook_idea: Slipping through a Comet Wall gap to hit COMBO x2 (+20) right as the ZIG-ZAG! swerving comets arrive at t=17.4-19.4s.
